wiki.title: Bryan Shupe
wiki.extract: Bryan W. Shupe is an American politician. He is a Republican member of the Delaware House of Representatives. He represents District 36, which includes south Milford, Ellendale, and Slaughter Beach. In 2018, Shupe was elected after winning the general election against Democratic nominee Don Allan. Prior to being elected to the Delaware House of Representatives, Shupe had served as mayor of the city of Milford.
